where: The Old Light, top — The Winding Room (Mr. Punchwheel, the great joke-drum)
mood: The Winding Room — the march at full delirium: every phrase climbs a key, the clockwork speeds up, then the spring snaps back.
_note: Classic oldlight-f7: 144, F→A♭→B→D then snap back. The tower's finale: joyous delirium, carnival-calliope energy, still cosy.
